failures.detail: Deterministic (failed in the full run and in 3 of 3 --only reruns, exit 1 each). The harness passes argv bytes ff fe 2d 78, 63 61 66 e9, etc.; the child observed efbfbdefbfbd2d78, 636166efbfbd, ... i.e. every invalid byte became U+FFFD (valid UTF-8 element 76616c696420c3bc passed intact). K8 in contract section 9 says invalid-UTF-8 argv is in scope on Unix, the check gates, and a stack that cannot pass it records a stack limitation and must not route around it (FFI via _NSGetArgv or /proc/self/cmdline counts as routing around, to be recorded as a production option only). The harness matches K8, so it is not a harness_defect and there is no contract ambiguity. Root cause per prototypes/ts/REPORT.md: Bun decodes argv to JS strings before user code runs. It is a genuine conformance failure, attributable to the stack. The prototype's own report already lists it as known defect 2 and escalation E2. The earlier E3 claim that the harness treats this check as non-gating is stale: the current harness (conformance.py sha256 f2ccd7e7...) gates it.
